purpose: RESEARCH PACKET ONLY. Not a replacement for the 533-product ledger; rows describe conditional subtype routes and may overlap prior reviewed products.
quality_warning: The 2022 source is historical. Before promoting a product to current exact-source evidence, confirm all subsequent official FSSAI amendments and the active finished-product facts. Official 2025 variants list is a mapping aid, not a regulation. No compliance PASS is inferred.
method: Positive finished-product identity/formulation/processing/physical-form test; no raw-ingredient contaminant leakage; separate quality/contaminant/additive/microbiological checks.
